goal: Let readers make rational choices between two flagship models based on habits, without creating opposition or insults.

canvas.split_line: Fine Vertical Line 1px #D6D0C8, Small Geometric VS (Non-Graffiti) Above the Center Seam

header.main_title: iPhone 16 Pro or Galaxy S25 Ultra? Understandable at a glance across 7 dimensions
header.subtitle: There are no absolute wins or losses, only whether you care about the iOS/Android ecosystem and telephoto style.

columns.name: iPhone 16 Pro
columns.color_theme: Titanium gray + misty blue, main and accent #1C1C1E + #0A84FF
columns.header_visual: Side view sketch of a titanium metal flat-edged body + dynamic island small pill outline (abstract)
columns.tagline: iOS ecosystem, Dolby Vision recording, A-series processing power, rich accessories

columns.name: Galaxy S25 Ultra
columns.color_theme: Deep ink + titanium embellishments, main and secondary #111111 + #C9A962
columns.header_visual: Simple line drawing of a square corner screen + an S Pen small slanted pen outline (no trademark).
columns.tagline: Android openness, custom themes, S Pen annotations, telephoto gameplay

comparison_rows.count: Fluorescent blue-purple gradient background steals the spotlight.
comparison_rows.structure: Left icon in the middle seam + Chinese dimension name, performance on each side + star rating (1-5) or check mark/cross line
items: Screen and grip (straight edge vs slightly wider square screen)
Long focal output (realistic vs high detail)
video workflow (Dolby + ecological unity vs. expandable storage)
System and Multi-Device (Relay with Mac vs Windows DeX, etc.)
Repairable and firmware (official channels + value retention vs. machine sea rhythm)
Starting price (RMB indicative range, subject to real-time e-commerce)
Suitable people (Apple fans + family bucket / tinkerer + Android).
comparison_rows.marker_style: 1-5 stars + light bottom horizontal bar + a small amount of text (≤6 characters)
comparison_rows.highlight_winner_per_row: true, with a slight amber base, not one-sided

footer.verdict: for seamless office work and video recording, prioritize iPhone; for large-screen handwriting + freedom on Android, prioritize S25 Ultra. Decision after physical product testing.

must_keep: Symmetrical widths for left and right columns
Each line has miniature icons (lens/screen/purse, etc. abstract)
